_note: Model panel lives in config, NOT code (kickoff Stage 2). ids are the exact strings passed to --ai / step(); provider is inferred from the id (see _provider_routing).
_deployment: Scoring data comes from CLOUD APIs (Gemini/Claude/GPT frontier tiers) + OPENROUTER (to audit the smaller / open-weights models) — expected to be sufficient to score, NO local GPU needed. Running selected models on the server's GPU cluster (Ollama) is a FUTURE step decided from the scores. The dev laptop authors + runs cheap cloud plumbing smoke; the full corpus scoring run can execute from laptop or server against cloud+OR APIs (M, 2026-07-15).
_provider_routing: AILANG GuessProvider infers the provider from the model-id: gemini-* -> Vertex (ADC); claude-* -> Anthropic direct (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY); gpt-*/o1/o3/codex -> OpenAI direct (OPENAI_API_KEY); ollama/<model> -> Ollama GPU via OLLAMA_HOST (no key); vendor/model or openrouter:<model> -> OpenRouter (OPENROUTER_API_KEY). Per-call step(model) needs the provider API name (dots), not the friendly --ai name. Canonical tier-descent execution: ONE `ailang run --ai <id>` per model (provider auto-selected), append to a shared results.jsonl.
_panel_selected: M, 2026-07-15: opus / sonnet / haiku (Anthropic direct) + gemma4 & deepseek-flash (OpenRouter). Final panel is M's call; swap ids in the driver and it just works.

budget._note: TWO LAYERS (confirmed with AILANG core 2026-07-15). (1) --routing-max-price = a per-token RATE ceiling, OpenRouter-only provider filter (now honest: filters providers, errors loudly on bad values, rejects on direct providers) — NOT a spend halt. (2) RUNNER-SIDE per-model TOKEN cap = the actual spend halt: runmodel.ail accumulates in+out tokens and stops THIS model at BUDGET_TOKENS, keeping partial results. The driver passes both per model. Reasoning models use ~6x tokens/item (gpt-5-mini 2370 vs gemini 391 live) — give them a higher cap.
budget.est_full_run: ~33 runnable x 5 models x 1 solve = ~165 calls; single-digit dollars

cache._correction: stepWithCache {position:system, ttl:ephemeral} is a NO-OP on Gemini + Ollama (v0.18.4): only Anthropic (direct or via OpenRouter) populates cache_read_input_tokens. Do NOT model cache savings on the Gemini/Ollama tiers.
